sections.content_markdown: **Work:** Determine the area of the dark marked region in the figure.

1. Angle subtended by a circular segment at the centre is $30^\circ$. If the diameter of the circle is $126\text{ cm}$, determine the length of the arc.

2. A horse circled around a field with a speed of $66\text{ metre per minute}$ in $1\frac{1}{2}\text{ minute}$. Determine the diameter of the field.

3. Area of a circular segment is $77\text{ square metre}$ and the radius is $21\text{ metre}$. Determine the angle subtended at the centre by the circular arc.

4. The radius of a circle is $14\text{ cm}$ and an arc subtends an angle $75^\circ$ at its centre. Determine the area of the circular segment.

5. There is a road around a circular field. The outer circumference of the road is greater than the inner circumference by $44\text{ meters}$. Find the width of the road.

6. The diameter of a circular park is $26\text{ metre}$. There is a road of $2\text{ metre width}$ surrounding the park. Determine the area of the road.

7. The diameter of the front wheel of a car is $28\text{ cm}$ and the back wheel is $35\text{ cm}$. To cover a distance of $88\text{ metre}$, how many integer number of times more the front wheel will revolve than the back one?

8. The circumference of a circle is $220\text{ metre}$. Determine the length of the side of the square, inscribed in the circle.

9. The circumference of a circle is equal to the perimeter of an equilateral triangle. Determine the ratio of their areas.
